email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Julia, saw dbt Labs launched dbt Copilot and crossed $100M ARR as it leans into AI-assisted data ops.

Growth like that usually means more in-market accounts than the sales team can cover, and that is where good-fit deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Julia, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

At $100M ARR and scaling, quota expectations grow faster than your selling capacity can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Julia, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data infrastructure firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Julia, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a Copilot launch there is plenty competing for your attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise data motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
